grants.description: Verify your identity using your GOV.UK One Login credentials
grants.purpose: To confirm your identity before checking your eligibility for 30 hours free childcare

grants.description: Check your employment status with HMRC records
grants.purpose: To verify that you meet the minimum working hours requirement

grants.description: Check your income from HMRC tax records
grants.purpose: To verify that you meet the minimum and maximum income requirements

grants.description: Check your partner's employment status and income (if you have a partner)
grants.purpose: To verify that your partner also meets the eligibility requirements
To confirm your child's age and identity for the childcare scheme

grants.description: Check if you receive any benefits that might affect eligibility
grants.purpose: To ensure you meet all eligibility criteria for 30 hours free childcare

grants.description: Allow HMRC to check your ongoing eligibility every 3 months
grants.purpose: To maintain your eligibility for 30 hours free childcare, as circumstances can change

revocation.mechanism: Contact HMRC Childcare Service or revoke through your Childcare Choices account
revocation.effect: Your childcare code will be deactivated and you will no longer be eligible for 30 hours free childcare. You may need to pay for childcare or reapply if circumstances change.

delegation.limitations: Agent cannot provide false information about employment or income. Agent cannot override HMRC's eligibility decision. Agent cannot share your childcare code with unauthorised parties. Agent cannot modify your child's personal details without your explicit confirmation. Agent cannot apply on behalf of someone else without proper delegation authority.
